claim: An owned nonmultiplexed SSH client was terminated; fresh reconnect observed the same native Dagu job running with one unchanged checkpoint, then native completion without stop or retry.
limitations: Controlled client termination and a deliberately detached deterministic job; not a real network outage, host restart, model-session recovery or distributed exactly-once guarantee.
First harness attempt misclassified native SSH exit255 and stopped the job; its narrower same-run finalizer retry is retained separately from corrected survival acceptance.
Original12-test oracle passed before and after; observed owned processes/listener retired; whole-task provider usage remains unknown.
